limitations: Both baseline and revised measurements reached the display's 60 FPS limit; the improvement is reduced GPU work, not a measured FPS increase.

Mobile layout was checked with a browser viewport override, not on physical low-end hardware.
Small moving vehicles no longer cast live shadows. Architectural shadows and baked ambient occlusion are retained.
